defects_found_by_this_smoke: advisory_schema_json() emitted a non-strict JSON Schema; codex exec --output-schema forwards it to a strict structured-output backend, which rejected the whole turn with a 400. Fixed by emitting the strict subset.

The Codex adapter reused the Claude Code advisory policy text, which forbids running commands. Codex reads files only by running commands in its read-only sandbox, so the prompt made the task impossible and Codex correctly reported it could not inspect the file. Fixed with a Codex-specific policy that forbids mutation rather than commands.
The committed fixture task carried the same assumption and was rewritten to be provider-neutral; fixture_version is now 2.

A non-zero CLI exit reported only 'non-zero status'. Claude Code reports the reason on stdout, so the runner now accepts an adapter-supplied diagnoser returning allowlisted metadata keys only, never a message body.
maximum_turns defaulted to 3, which an ordinary read-then-answer task exhausts. Raised to 6; it is a cost bound, not a safety boundary.
gaps: S21C2-075 requires three live smokes. OpenRouter was deferred by operator decision, so this condition is partially met and Gate C2 must report it as such rather than as a pass.

operator_approval.decision: The operator approved the two local CLI live smokes and deferred OpenRouter. OPENROUTER_API_KEY was not present and no OpenRouter call was attempted.
